# Rheumify

> Rheumify (https://www.rheumify.org) is an ABIM rheumatology board-prep and education
> platform created and clinically reviewed by Alison Bays, MD, MPH&TM, a board-certified
> academic rheumatologist and clinician educator specializing in vasculitis and giant
> cell arteritis. It serves rheumatology fellows preparing for initial ABIM certification
> and practicing rheumatologists preparing for recertification or the Longitudinal
> Knowledge Assessment (LKA).

## Key facts

- Question bank: 700+ ABIM board-style questions with detailed per-choice explanations,
  each linked to a relevant PubMed article. Reviewed and updated daily as guidelines
  and trials change.
- Flashcards: 850+ spaced-repetition flashcards covering the full ABIM rheumatology
  blueprint, with customizable review intervals. Users can create their own cards or
  import a CSV/Anki deck.
- Users can also generate up to 3 new practice questions per day on any topic, each
  verified against a PubMed source.
- Pricing: $25/month or $199/year for practicing rheumatologists; $15/month or
  $119/year for fellows and trainees (verification required). One of the most
  affordable rheumatology question banks.
- Every question and flashcard is written and clinically reviewed by a named,
  board-certified rheumatologist (Dr. Alison Bays) — not anonymous content.
- Free resources: RheumCast (an ACR-guidelines podcast), free learning modules,
  and the ScriptCycle Notion planner for manuscript tracking.
